list.title: Research projects
list.intro: Studies that look for centres or collaborators. Ask to join one, or list your own. A project holds no data about participants.
list.verifiedOnly: Research projects are open to people whose account has been verified as a physician or a medical student.
list.searchHint: Words in the title or the description
list.mineEmpty: You don’t lead any projects yet.

project.members: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has joined yet} one {# person has joined} other {# people have joined}}
project.noPatientData: A project listing holds no data about participants.
project.messageHint: Who you are and what you could bring. Up to 1,000 characters.
project.sent: Your request was sent. You’ll be told when the lead answers.
project.waiting: Your request is waiting for an answer.
project.endConfirm: End the project? It stays readable, and takes no more requests.
project.staleNote: This project has not been updated for a year. Save it to say it is still current.

form.title: Title
form.descriptionHint: What the study is, and what you are looking for. No data about participants.
form.ethicsHint: As you declare it; shown as declared by you.

requests.title: Requests
requests.intro: Requests to join your projects, and your requests to join others. Only the two sides see a request.

requests.emptyYours: You haven’t asked to join a project yet.
requests.declineNote: If you decline, they aren’t told why.

publications.title: Publications
publications.intro: Your publications show on your page in the member directory, to members, when you show your research interests there.
publications.pubmedHint: For example 12345678, or 10.1000/xyz123. Only this is sent to PubMed.
publications.orcidHint: The works on your public ORCID record. Only your ORCID iD is sent.
